goal: Look up member ${input.member_id} and open their detail page. The account table's column headers have small icon-only controls (no text labels) for sorting and filtering — work out which is which yourself. Use the filter control on the Account Type column to show only ${input.filter_account_type} accounts, then read the ${input.filter_account_type} balance. Finally, open a new ${input.account_type} sub-account for this member with an initial deposit of $${input.initial_deposit}, and reach the confirmation screen.
